name: Eye Blink
description: Curved eyelids close over the first clip, which blurs and dims, then open on the second as it comes back into focus. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: blur
params.description: How much the picture blurs and dims while the eyes are closed

params.name: softness
params.description: Width of the soft shadow along the eyelid rims

params.name: blinks
params.description: Number of blinks: 1, or 2 for a quick double blink
